marta_bench: Quick check — Sienna Core joint bench sprint tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final telemetry schema, kernel flag list, and marketplace artifact naming. Who can own which piece?
kevin_hw_partner: I can own the kernel flags + test harness. Will push a flags list to the partner repo by EOD. Any naming convention for variants?
liz_prod: Marketplace side needs a short how-we-measured blurb, perf/W table, and the model artifact SHA. Marta — can you confirm the exact perf metrics we want surfaced?
marta_bench: Perf metrics = p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec (throughput), watts idle and watts under target load, perf/W at standard seq lengths, and batch efficiency. Also we want a thermal-soak curve (temp vs time). Quick telemetry schema sample below:
```json
{"run_id":"string","model":"string","variant":"string","timestamp":"iso8601","tokens_generated":int,"tokens_per_s":float,"p50_ms":float,"p95_ms":float,"gpu_power_w":float,"cpu_power_w":float,"gpu_temp_c":float,"wall_time_s":float}
```
kevin_hw_partner: Need KV-cache warmup steps in the harness. Can you share the warmup command? Also list of kernel modules you'll want compiled. cc @sam_eng
sam_eng: Warmup script to call in harness: ```bash
./run_bench --model redwood-v1 --seq 2048 --batch 1 --warmup 50 --track-telemetry /tmp/tele.json
```
Kernel flags we'll try: `default`, `fuse-attn`, `reduce-alloc`, `int8-quant`. For compile-time: `-DENABLE_FUSE_ATTENTION`, `-DREDUCE_ALLOC` and the usual vendor toolchain flags. We'll test three configs: high-throughput (fuse-attn), energy-optimized (int8-quant + reduce-alloc), balanced (default + minor kernel tweaks).
liz_prod: Marketplace requirements: include a one-paragraph measurement method, raw telemetry CSV attached, plus per-variant perf/W row. Also SLA fields (p95 <= X ms) are helpful for listing.
kevin_hw_partner: We'll instrument with a power meter and publish watts to benchbot. One question on artifact naming: current convention at our side is `sienna-<model>-<quant>-<kernel>.tar.gz` — is that fine?
marta_bench: That naming works. We'll standardize an artifact metadata file with fields: artifact_name, sha256, build_date, kernel_flags, quant_mode, test_commit. Also telemetry field names we'll accept: `gpu_temp_c`,`gpu_power_w`,`tokens_per_s`,`p50_ms`,`p95_ms`,`wall_time_s`.
benchbot: Automated: dry run scheduled today 17:00 PT in lab-3. Results will auto-post to /bench/reports/1729999999 and notify this thread. :robot_face: 
kevin_hw_partner: Acknowledged. I'll bring a spare power-feed adapter and the updated kernel module for the FuseAttn build.
liz_prod: I'll draft the marketplace blurb after the dry run — ping me the results link and the chosen three variants.
marta_bench: Thanks. After dry run let's pick three public candidates: 1) throughput-optimized, 2) energy-optimized, 3) balanced. Prefer to have one that hits >X tokens/s at <=Y W. See you at 17:00 for the dry run.
